newsitem.title: USA: NYSE options to move to CBOE on April 28.
newsitem.headline: NYSE options to move to CBOE on April 28.

text.p: The Chicago Board Options Exchange (CBOE) said Wednesday the New York Stock Exchange's (NYSE) options market will move to the CBOE effective April 28.
An exchange spokesman confirmed a report that the CBOE would issue permits to 40 to 50 floor traders and specialists who will be moving to Chicago.
Last October, the CBOE began negotiations to purchase the NYSE's options unit and recently signed an agreement to pay $5 million for it.
The deal must still be approved by the Securities and Exchange Commission.
The CBOE spokesman confirmed that the additional options business--about 150 options not traded at the CBOE are listed on the NYSE--will create 125 to 150 trading and support jobs in Chicago.
